links.outcome: ML model AUC versus 12 specialists' predictions of metastatic disease on same data
links.effect: Model AUC 0.942 (95% CI 0.894-0.969) exceeded best specialist before (0.815) and after (0.812) SDHB data, p<0.0001.
links.quote: This model had an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0·942 (95% CI 0·894-0·969) that was larger (p<0·0001) than that of the best performing specialist before (0·815, 0·778-0·853) and after (0·812, 0·781-0·854) provision of SDHB variant data.

links.outcome: External validation of ML models on separate multicentre prospective cohort
links.effect: Models trained on retrospective NIH/PRESCRIPT data were externally validated on PMT trial; sensitivity 83% at specificity 92%.
links.quote: Sensitivity for prediction of metastatic disease in the external validation cohort reached 83% at a specificity of 92%.

screen.reason: Evaluates a predictive machine learning model for metastatic pheochromocytoma/paraganglioma and compares its performance against 12 clinical specialists on an external validation cohort, but does not test a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
